lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਿ ਦੈਤਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaal dait sa(n)ghaare jam pur gae ||2||
lines.translation: They are destroyed by Death's demons, and they must go to the City of Death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har har har liv laage ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are lovingly attached to the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dooo dukh bhaage ||3||
lines.translation: Their pains of both birth and death are taken away. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kau har kirapaa dhaaree ||
lines.translation: The Lord showers His Mercy on His humble devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa miliaa banavaaree ||4||2||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak has shown mercy to me; I have met the Lord, the Lord of the forest. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲੁਕਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ratan kothaRee gaR ma(n)dar ek lukaanee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is a jewel, hidden in a chamber of the palace of the body-fortress.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai ta khojeeai mil jotee jot samaanee ||1||
lines.translation: When one meets the True Guru, then he searches and finds it, and his light merges with the Divine Light. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadho saadhoo jan dehu milaai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, lead me to meet with the Holy Person, the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekhat daras paap sabh naasahi pavitr param pad paai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my sins are erased, and I obtain the supreme, sublime, sanctified status. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਗਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch chor mil laage nagareeaa raam naam dhan hiriaa ||
lines.translation: The five thieves join together and plunder the body-village, stealing the wealth of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜ ਪਰੇ ਤਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਉਬਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramat khoj pare tab pakare dhan saabat raas ubariaa ||2||
lines.translation: But through the Guru's Teachings, they are traced and caught, and this wealth is recovered intact. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਭਰਮ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paakha(n)d bharam upaav kar thaake rid a(n)tar maaiaa maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Practicing hypocrisy and superstition, people have grown weary of the effort, but still, deep within their hearts, they yearn for Maya, Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo purakh purakhapat paaiaa agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Holy Person, I have met with the Lord, the Primal Being, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaga(n)naath jagadees gusaaee kar kirapaa saadh milaavai ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Lord of the Earth, the Lord of the Universe, in His Mercy, leads me to meet the Holy Person, the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saa(n)t hovai man a(n)tar nit hiradai har gun gaavai ||4||1||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, peace then comes to abide deep within my mind, and I constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||4||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 4 hi(n)dol ||
lines.translation: Basant, Fourth Mehl, Hindol:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਨਛੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumh vad purakh vad agam gusaaee ham keere kiram tumanachhe ||
lines.translation: You are the Great Supreme Being, the Vast and Inaccessible Lord of the World; I am a mere insect, a worm created by You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਬਨਛੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har deen daiaal karahu prabh kirapaa gur satigur charan ham banachhe ||1||
lines.translation: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, please grant Your Grace; O God, I long for the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਛੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d jeeu satasa(n)gat mel kar kripachhe ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please be merciful and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਨਛੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh mal bhariaa mil sa(n)gat kar prabh hanachhe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I was overflowing with the filthy sins of countless past lives. But joining the Sangat, God made me pure again. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਵਿਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumhraa jan jaat avijaataa har japio patit paveechhe ||
lines.translation: Your humble servant, whether of high class or low class, O Lord - by meditating on You, the sinner becomes pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਿਨਛੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har keeo sagal bhavan te oopar har sobhaa har prabh dinachhe ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord exalts and elevates him above the whole world, and the Lord God blesses him with the Lord's Glory. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਨਸ ਤਿਨਛੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaat ajaat koee prabh dhiaavai sabh poore maanas tinachhe ||
lines.translation: Anyone who meditates on God, whether of high class or low class, will have all of his hopes and desires fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਛੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: se dha(n)n vade vad poore har jan jinh har dhaario har urachhe ||3||
lines.translation: Those humble servants of the Lord who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, are blessed, and are made great and totally perfect. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਢੀਂਢੇ ਢੀਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਛੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham dhee(n)dhe dheem bahut at bhaaree har dhaar kripaa prabh milachhe ||
lines.translation: I am so low, I am an utterly heavy lump of clay. Please shower Your Mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੂਠੇ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur paaiaa har toothe ham keee patit paveechhe ||4||2||4||
lines.translation: The Lord, in His Mercy, has led servant Nanak to find the Guru; I was a sinner, and now I have become immaculate and pure. ||||4||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਗੀਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa ik khin manooaa rahi na sakai nit har har naam ras geedhe ||
lines.translation: My mind cannot survive, even for an instant, without the Lord. I drink in continually the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਥਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਥਨਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲੀਧੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu baarik rasak pario than maataa than kaadhe bilal bileedhe ||1||
lines.translation: It is like a baby, who joyfully sucks at his mother's breast; when the breast is withdrawn, he weeps and cries. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d jeeu mere man tan naam har beedhe ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord of the Universe, my mind and body are pierced through by the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag gur satigur paaiaa vich kaaiaa nagar har seedhe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru, and in the body-village, the Lord has revealed Himself. ||1||Pause||
